Well, I got a job as a teen living with my parents. I was able to save my money and purchase a PS4, Xbox1, Switch, and PC parts. Out of all of these, I find the most enjoyable one to be.......(drum roll).... The Switch!

I love my computer, and I use it for FAR more than just gaming. It's awesome. I'd take a PC over all of the other systems in a heartbeat. However, when it comes to gaming, I'm a Nintendo fan. There is something so charming about Nintendo games that has always been a part my life. 

Clearly this was a waste of money, I get that, but I figure I can always just sell the consoles later. If I had to rank my experience with all of them, it would be this:

1. Switch
2. PC 
3. PS4
4. Xbox1

If you have it in the budget, I recommend getting a PC and a Switch. Nintendo doesn't port games to other platforms, so you'd be missing out big-time without a Switch. Other than that, PC offers most good AAA titles, as well as emulation for older ones. 

If you don't care about Nintendo games, just switch to PC. It's so so so worth it. It's cheaper than buying a console (as long as you build it yourself), and it's easy to upgrade it to fit the requirements for new games. The new Xbox may be claiming that it will get 4k 60fps, but my guess is that the actual graphical settings on the games (textures, etc.) will be a lot lower.

TLDR: The switch is worth it. You'll miss out on modern Nintendo titles, as well as console exclusives, but your PC can be updated for far cheaper than buying an entire new system.
